heading.title: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases

article.title: Thirty days.
article.content:
Under the Arbitration Act, 1940 (10 of 1940),—
(a)for the filing in court of an award;
Period of limitationThirty days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of service of the notice of the making of the award;



(b)for setting aside an award or getting an award remitted for reconsideration.
Period of limitationThirty days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of service of the notice of the filing of the award.
